verdict.rationale: Letta's 'dreaming' feature explicitly uses background subagents to review conversations, extract salient lessons, and consolidate/update memory without interrupting active work, and /remember and /init let the agent decide where lessons belong in MemFS autonomously. Community corroboration (Charles/Wooders on HN) confirms this memory-first, self-consolidating design and contrasts it with RAG-based approaches, though skeptics questioned scaling. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of extraction quality/accuracy and more detail on the automatic (non-explicit) salience-detection heuristics beyond trigger conditions.
